userPrompt: What is the tallest mountain on Earth?
responseText:
**Mount Everest**, at 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) above sea level.

It is the tallest mountain on Earth when measured from sea level to summit. (If measured from base to peak, Mauna Kea in Hawaii is taller due to its underwater base, but Everest holds the standard elevation record.)
